newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates steady to firmer.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates steady to firmer.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were slightly up in the one-week to one-month and one-year maturities, while the rest were unchanged, traders said on Friday.
"The market is just firming up," a trader said, adding that banks are adopting a wait-and-see attitude on any Central Bank move on interest rates.

PHIBOR, which represents the rates at which banks are willing to swap their pesos for dollars, had been on the decline in recent days on expectations the Central Bank may further cut its overnight rates.
Early in the week, the Central Bank cuts its overnight rates by 1.50 percentage points with the easing of speculation at the foreign exchange market.
